result.instructions: Tools for 17TRACK, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my tracked parcels have already been delivered?"; "How much of my tracking quota have I used so far?"; "List the parcels I am tracking and their current delivery status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes 17TRACK data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run track17_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run track17_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run track17_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. track17_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: track17_get_quota
tools.title: Get tracking quota
tools.description: The account's tracking quota: total, used, remaining, used today, the daily registration limit (0 = no limit) and the free e-mail quota. Each registered tracking number uses 1 quota. POST /getquota.

tools.name: track17_list_tracking_numbers
tools.title: List registered tracking numbers
tools.description: Search the tracking numbers registered on this account (40 per page) with their carrier, status, registration and last-update times, and latest event. Filter by number(s), carrier, tracking state, package status or registration date. Free: it does not use quota. POST /gettracklist.

items.description: Tracking number (5-50 letters, digits or hyphens).

carrier.description: 17TRACK numeric carrier code (for example 3011 = China Post, 100003 = FedEx). Full list: https://res.17track.net/asset/carrier/info/apicarrier.all.json

tracking_status.description: Only numbers currently being tracked, or stopped.

package_status.description: Only packages in this main status.

register_time_from.description: Registered on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

register_time_to.description: Registered on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

page_no.description: Page number, from 1 (omit for the first page). Use the reply's next_page.

tools.name: track17_get_tracking
tools.title: Get tracking details
tools.description: Full tracking details (status, sub-status, milestones, every carrier event with time and location, estimated delivery) for up to 10 numbers that are ALREADY registered on this account. Free: it does not use quota. A number that is not registered comes back in `rejected` — register it first with track17_register_numbers, or use track17_realtime_lookup. POST /gettrackinfo.

number.description: Tracking number (5-50 letters, digits or hyphens).

carrier.description: 17TRACK numeric carrier code (for example 3011 = China Post, 100003 = FedEx). Full list: https://res.17track.net/asset/carrier/info/apicarrier.all.json

numbers.description: Registered numbers, each with an optional carrier code (needed if the number is tracked under several carriers).

tools.name: track17_realtime_lookup
tools.title: Real-time lookup of one number
tools.description: WRITE (uses quota): look up ONE tracking number directly at the carrier right now, without registering it. Costs 1 quota per call (standard: carrier data up to 3 hours old). If the number is already registered, a changed result is also pushed to the account. Not supported for USPS, Royal Mail, Australia Post, Direct Freight Express, DHL eCommerce US and DHL Global Forwarding; some accounts are not enabled for real-time lookups. POST /getRealTimeTrackInfo.

number.description: Tracking number (5-50 letters, digits or hyphens).

carrier.description: 17TRACK numeric carrier code (for example 3011 = China Post, 100003 = FedEx). Full list: https://res.17track.net/asset/carrier/info/apicarrier.all.json

destination_postal_code.description: Recipient postal code, for carriers that require it.

phone_number_last_4.description: Last 4 digits of the recipient phone, for carriers that require it.

tools.name: track17_register_numbers
tools.title: Register tracking numbers
tools.description: WRITE (uses quota): start tracking up to 10 tracking numbers per call. Each ACCEPTED number costs 1 quota from this account (see track17_get_quota); rejected numbers cost nothing. Deleting and re-registering a number costs again. 17TRACK then updates the status itself every 6-12 hours; read it with track17_get_tracking. The carrier is detected automatically unless a carrier code is given. No e-mail notifications are enabled. POST /register.

number.description: Tracking number (5-50 letters, digits or hyphens).

carrier.description: 17TRACK numeric carrier code (for example 3011 = China Post, 100003 = FedEx). Full list: https://res.17track.net/asset/carrier/info/apicarrier.all.json

tag.description: Your own label for the shipment (max 100 characters), for example an order id.

lang.description: Translation language code, for example en.

origin_country.description: Origin country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (for example CN).

destination_postal_code.description: Recipient postal code, required by some carriers.

phone_number_last_4.description: Last 4 digits of the recipient phone, required by some carriers.

tools.name: track17_change_carrier
tools.title: Change the carrier of a number
tools.description: WRITE: assign a different carrier to registered tracking numbers (up to 10 per call), for example when auto-detection picked the wrong one. A number can change carrier at most 5 times, and a successful change can be charged as one shipment (see track17_get_quota). POST /changecarrier.

number.description: Tracking number (5-50 letters, digits or hyphens).

carrier_old.description: The current carrier code; only needed when the number is tracked under several carriers.

annotations.title: Change the carrier of a number

tools.name: track17_change_tag
tools.title: Change the tag of a number
tools.description: WRITE: set the tag (your own label, max 100 characters) of a registered tracking number. It replaces the old tag. Free. POST /changeinfo.

number.description: Tracking number (5-50 letters, digits or hyphens).

carrier.description: Carrier code; needed if the number is tracked under several carriers.

tag.description: The new tag (max 100 characters; an empty string clears it).

annotations.title: Change the tag of a number

tools.name: track17_stop_tracking
tools.title: Stop tracking numbers
tools.description: WRITE: stop tracking registered numbers (up to 10 per call). The numbers stay in the account for 90 days with their history and can be restarted ONCE each with track17_retrack. Stopping does not refund quota. POST /stoptrack.

number.description: Tracking number (5-50 letters, digits or hyphens).

carrier.description: 17TRACK numeric carrier code (for example 3011 = China Post, 100003 = FedEx). Full list: https://res.17track.net/asset/carrier/info/apicarrier.all.json

tools.name: track17_retrack
tools.title: Restart tracking of stopped numbers
tools.description: WRITE: restart tracking of stopped numbers (up to 10 per call). Each number can be restarted only ONCE in its lifetime, so a second restart is rejected. POST /retrack.

number.description: Tracking number (5-50 letters, digits or hyphens).

carrier.description: 17TRACK numeric carrier code (for example 3011 = China Post, 100003 = FedEx). Full list: https://res.17track.net/asset/carrier/info/apicarrier.all.json
